sources.citation: Fabre, Alain. 2005- (entry modified 2007). 'Kambiwá'. Diccionario etnolingüístico y guía bibliográfica de los pueblos indígenas sudamericanos. 2 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Bibliographic entry only: 'Lengua aislada de un grupo étnico que hoy habla solamente portugués'; Meader 1978 named as the only linguistic data. Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Barbosa, Wallace de Deus. 1991. Os índios Kambiwá de Pernambuco: arte e identidade étnica. Dissertação de Mestrado, Escola de Belas Artes, UFRJ. 151 pp. (note 21, p. 98: glossary of remembered words)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: c. 25 remembered words in Portuguese spelling; author states explicitly 'não contando entretanto, com a transcrição fonética, tal como normalmente é feita pelos lingüístas'. Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Meader, Robert E. (ed.). 1978. Índios do Nordeste: levantamento sobre os remanescentes tribais do Nordeste brasileiro. Brasília: Summer Institute of Linguistics. 94 pp. (Kambiwá: sec. 1.2 p. 14; sec. 3.3 'Kambiwá. Lista 1 / Lista 2', pp. 36-37, collected by Wilbur Pickering, 1961)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No prose statement. pp. 36-37 give c. 26 remembered words in phonetic transcription with a primary-stress stroke on most tokens (List 1, Manoel de Souza: ˈkólúmì, ˈtóì, ˈpóřùi, ˈšíˈtúrù, ˈkákʷì, ˈkóną, ˈtšʸářítšʸà, tã·ˈkážúpì, ˈtʸápɔsɛřɛ̨, ˈřúpąų, ˈtúpàřà, ˈfóiàsà, ˈfilípį, ˈkąñíkį — nearly all initial; List 2, Tenoro: břázádò, pą̃ˈhúì, ˈkóìm, ąžúˈkà, álúˈà, ˈtšʸápàřú, ˈnɛkřu, púsɛ́ˈrɛ̨, ˈgʷášínì, pǫį, ˈgʷą́wų̀ — mixed). No transcription-conventions note anywhere in the volume (Notas pp. 93-94 checked).

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Kambiwá language'; Wikipedia (pt) 'Língua cambiuá' (reference lists; reproduce Pompeu Sobrinho 1958, Meader 1978 and Barbosa 1991 word lists; cite Campbell 2024)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress; used only to enumerate the attestation (27 words 1935, 25 words c. 1955, Pickering 1961) and to locate Barbosa 1991 and Fabre 2005.

sources.note: 'Cambioá - once spoken in the Serra Negra, Pernambuco state.' / 'Quiambioá - once spoken in the Serra Negra, Pernambuco.' Listed as unknown languages; no data, nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Loukotka, Čestmír. 1963. Documents et vocabulaires inédits de langues et de dialectes sud-américains. Journal de la Société des Américanistes 52: 7-60. doi:10.3406/jsa.1963.2001 (per-page scanned harvested from Persée, all 54 pages)
sources.note: No 'Kambiwá' heading; item 8 'Pankarurú' p. 15 = 16 words from Oliveira's and Carneiro's manuscripts (Brejo dos Padres), reattributed to Kambiwá by Campbell 2024/Glottolog. Bare word forms with acute accents (porkiá, tiùpanyé, panyé); nothing on stress.
